I recommend approving case B-052. Every requirement in the SOP is met and no risk factor applies.

- **Beneficial ownership (3.2–3.4):** Lena Brandt, the CEO, is the control person. The three owners hold 21%, 21% and 58%, which adds up to 100%, so nobody else could own 25% or more. Rosa Castillo is the only owner at or above 25%, and she is identified. The certification matches the ownership record. All three individuals have verified IDs.
- **Registry filing (3.5):** Filed 2026-06-08, which is under 5 months before the review date of 2026-10-27, so it's within the 6-month limit.
- **Screening (4.1–4.4):** No sanctions matches, no PEPs and no adverse media on the entity or any of the three individuals.
- **Industry and geography (5, 6.1–6.2):** The industry is normal, so the unverified licence doesn't matter (it only applies to money services businesses). The entity and all three individuals are US-based.

One gap to note: section 4.4 says every adverse-media search should be recorded with its terms, date and sources. The evidence only gives "no" for each party, with no search details. I treated "no" as established, so this doesn't change the outcome, but the search records should be kept on file.
